name: Graveyard ward
description: A graveyard as a part of the place of its own (a cemetery, a burial ground): fenced plots of graves in rows, paths between them, old trees, and perhaps a chapel. Plan it when the request places a graveyard somewhere in the place (at the east, at its edge, on a hill); the small graveyard inside a temple ward is the temple's own churchyard.

extent.description: How big it is in the real world (a plan cell is 2 m): small = a churchyard of a hamlet (about 25 x 25 m); normal = a village graveyard (about 45 x 45 m); big = a large village's graveyard (about 65 x 70 m); huge = a town cemetery (about 110 x 110 m). The plan's size follows it.

walled.description: Whether the graveyard has a wall or fence around its border (with an open gate).
